description: happy path: all four sources; run report aggregated only (no interval; abstention rates all 0 or 1 so Wilson bounds are n/(n+z^2)); explain CSV without claim counts (one question not in the benchmark, one FALSE in capitals); audit with 2 attempts of equal ratios and demo answers with equal ratios, so every bootstrap bound equals the point value; demo-2 has no evidence list (untyped claims); a --label for the run report is ignored because the file holds the value
